scientific_integrity: The general result is derived analytically. Finite checks serve as corroboration only. No independent review or completeness certification of the historical literature is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Planar finite cyclic normal systems with strict gaps below pi; ray counts are for the labeled parameter cone modulo translations and not its convex-hull image. Existing redundancy lemmas and standard positive-circuit facts are credited; historical priority remains uncertain.
title: Minimal facets and circuit rays of planar prescribed-normal vertex cones
